descricao: Papel marfim texturizado, título enorme condensado em preto com palavras-chave em vermelho escuro, texto de apoio serifado e escultura clássica de mármore no canto inferior direito, às vezes com um círculo vermelho atrás.

ilustracoes.prompt_escultura: A classical Greek or Roman white marble sculpture, {pose}. Realistic carved marble with soft natural light from the upper left, subtle warm shadows, museum photography, highly detailed curls and drapery. The figure is cut off at the chest/waist at the bottom edge of the image. Isolated object, fully transparent background, no pedestal, no text, no frame.
ilustracoes.prompt_icone: A minimal flat line icon of {assunto}, drawn with a single dark crimson red color (#A8141C), thin uniform stroke with a few solid filled shapes, simple and elegant like an editorial magazine pictogram. Centered, fully transparent background, no text, no shadow.
